name: International Cooperation Scheme- Capacity Building of First Time MSE Exporters
benefit:
> **Scale of Assistance and Eligible Items of Expenditure:**

Financial assistance towards costs incurred by first-time MSE Exporters on export shipments:-
Registration-cum-Membership Certificate (RCMC) charges/fee paid by the first-time exporter to relate EPCs 75% of the cost paid subject to a maximum of ₹20,000/- or actual, whichever is lower subject to quarterly reporting by EPCs as per prescri
_eligibility_text:
1. The Micro and Small Enterprises with valid Udyam Registration are eligible to apply under the scheme.
   1. To claim the benefits under the scheme, the applicant&#39;s Importer Exporter Code (IEC) must not be older than 3 years on the date of export shipment.
